scientific_integrity: The sharp three-step phase transition is demonstrated analytically by exact Rayleigh differences. Finite symbolic/rational tests supplement but do not prove the infinite-index covariance statement. No external independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact strong-Rayleigh classification concerns first three jump indicators only. Bernoulli-sum count representation follows from a published PGF and classical Meixner orthogonality; it is not the novelty claim. No inference for higher-dimensional strong Rayleigh. General atom-bearing record-process results may overlap the sharp threshold and require specialist priority review.
title: A minimal three-step strong-Rayleigh transition in a discrete hyperbolic staircase
